title: 2017 年 6 月英语六级真题（第 2 套）

analysis.topic: 宋朝经济、科技与社会发展概述
analysis.reference: The Song Dynasty, which started in 960, lasted until 1279. During this period, China's economy grew substantially, making it the most advanced economy in the world, with science, technology, philosophy, and mathematics all flourishing. China in the Song Dynasty was the first country in world history to issue paper money. The Song Dynasty was also the first to use gunpowder and invented movable-type printing. The population grew rapidly, and more and more people moved into cities, where there were bustling entertainment venues. Social life was rich and varied. People gathered together to view and trade precious works of art. The government system of the Song Dynasty was also advanced for its time. Government officials were all selected and appointed through competitive examinations.

sentences.cn: 宋朝始于960年，一直延续到1279年。
sentences.en: The Song Dynasty started in 960 and lasted until 1279.
sentences.structure: 简单句，两个并列谓语 started…and lasted… 共用主语
keys: 始于 started in / began in
延续到 lasted until / continued until

sentences.cn: 这一时期，中国经济大幅增长，成为世界上最先进的经济体，科学、技术、哲学和数学蓬勃发展。
sentences.en: During this period, China's economy grew substantially, making it the most advanced economy in the world, with science, technology, philosophy, and mathematics all flourishing.
sentences.structure: 时间状语 + 主句 + 现在分词短语作结果状语 + with 复合结构表伴随
keys: 大幅增长 grew substantially / increased significantly
最先进的经济体 the most advanced economy

sentences.cn: 宋代中国是世界历史上首先发行纸币的国家。
sentences.en: China in the Song Dynasty was the first country in world history to issue paper money.
sentences.structure: 主系表结构，the first … to do 不定式作后置定语
keys: 发行纸币 issue paper money
世界历史上 in world history

sentences.cn: 宋朝还最早使用火药并发明了活字印刷。
sentences.en: The Song Dynasty was also the first to use gunpowder and invented movable-type printing.
sentences.structure: 并列谓语结构，was the first to do … and invented …

sentences.cn: 人口增长迅速，越来越多的人住进城市，那里有热闹的娱乐场所。
sentences.en: The population grew rapidly, and more and more people moved into cities, where there were bustling entertainment venues.
sentences.structure: 并列句 + where 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 cities
keys: 人口增长迅速 the population grew rapidly
热闹的娱乐场所 bustling entertainment venues

sentences.en: Social life was rich and varied.
sentences.structure: 主系表结构，形容词并列作表语
keys: 多种多样 rich and varied / diverse and colorful

sentences.cn: 人们聚集在一起观看和交易珍贵艺术品。
sentences.en: People gathered together to view and trade precious works of art.
sentences.structure: 主谓结构 + 不定式短语作目的状语
keys: 珍贵艺术品 precious works of art

sentences.cn: 宋朝的政府体制在当时也是先进的。
sentences.en: The government system of the Song Dynasty was also advanced for its time.
sentences.structure: 主系表结构，for its time 作状语表时间参照
keys: 在当时 for its time / at that time

sentences.cn: 政府官员均通过竞争性考试选拔任用。
sentences.en: Government officials were all selected and appointed through competitive examinations.
sentences.structure: 被动语态，through 引导方式状语
keys: 选拔任用 selected and appointed

keys.en: precious works of art / valuable artworks

pitfalls: the Song Dynasty 中 Dynasty 首字母须大写，且第一次出现常加 the
issue paper money 中 issue 易误写为 release 或 publish，语境不当
movable-type 中间须加连字符，漏写连字符会扣分
was the first to use 结构中 to 不可省略，否则语法错误
selected and appointed 须用被动语态，主语是官员而非政府

upgrades.better: China's economy grew substantially / expanded dramatically
upgrades.note: substantially 和 dramatically 更书面、更精确地传达'大幅'之意

upgrades.better: science, technology, philosophy, and mathematics all flourished
upgrades.note: flourish 一词传达'蓬勃发展'的生机感，比 develop quickly 更地道
bustling 比 lively 更生动，venues 比 places 更正式精准

upgrades.better: Social life was rich and varied
upgrades.note: rich and varied 是固定搭配，比 many kinds 更符合英文表达习惯

upgrades.plain: was also advanced at that time
upgrades.better: was also advanced for its time
upgrades.note: for its time 是地道英文惯用表达，含'以当时标准衡量'之意
